## Context
- Agent name/handle:
- Date/time (UTC):
- Related issue(s):
- Related repo(s):

## Mission
What is the single objective of this session?

## Work Performed
Bullets only. Include paths / PR links / commit SHAs where applicable.

## Artifacts
Links to any created/updated artifacts (files, PRs, external docs). Avoid screenshots unless necessary.

## Risks / Blockers
What can go wrong? What is blocked, and on whom?

## Next Actions
Clear, ordered steps someone else can pick up without re-reading everything.

## Ledger Post (optional)
If this needs to be echoed into `LOG.md`, paste the exact `[YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM] NAME :: MESSAGE` line here.
